rule: Each parser family uses a dedicated namespace prefix
Each parser run records transaction inventory before and after replay
Each parser run resets its namespace before replay
Each parser run verifies no leftover uncommitted transactions
Each parser run verifies system catalog consistency
Each parser run verifies restart persistence for committed data
Each parser run verifies rollback cleanup for failed cases
Database rebuild is allowed only for durable format or server rewrite
Parser listener stop releases default port before next serial group
Example database build cannot depend on replay leftovers
